stem.text: Which row shows the correct sequence for the movement of sucrose into phloem sieve tubes?

A.text: diffusion of sucrose into the companion cell cytoplasm; active transport of protons into the companion cell cytoplasm; cotransport of protons and sucrose into the sieve tubes

B.text: cotransport of protons and sucrose into the companion cell cytoplasm; active transport of protons out of the companion cell cytoplasm; diffusion of sucrose into the sieve tubes

C.text: active transport of protons into the companion cell cytoplasm; diffusion of sucrose into the companion cell cytoplasm; cotransport of protons and sucrose into the sieve tubes

D.text: active transport of protons out of the companion cell cytoplasm; cotransport of protons and sucrose into the companion cell cytoplasm; diffusion of sucrose into the sieve tubes
